summary: The user's own settings: change password (re-wrap the DEK, never re-encrypt records), a read-only main currency, dimension configuration inside the encrypted profile record, session/idle-lock management, and self-service account deletion.

read.role: password, main currency, session/lock, delete-account screen
form, chip, and table conventions for the password/session/delete-account and dimension screens, and the authenticated shell they render inside

profileRecordPayload.value: { mainCurrency (required), createdAt (required), idleLockMinutes (optional, 5-60, absent=15), dimensions (optional, absent/empty = none) }

changePasswordEndpoint.value: POST /api/auth/change-password { currentAuthKey, salt, kdf, authKey, wrappedDek, dekNonce }

changePasswordEffect.value: no vault record is re-encrypted; only salt, KDF envelope, Auth Key hash, and wrapped DEK are replaced, in one transaction, at the server's current default KDF parameters; invalidates every other session, keeps the current one

deleteAccountEndpoint.value: DELETE /api/auth/account { authKey, confirmUsername } — deletes user row, every record, every session in one transaction; 400 on authKey or confirmUsername mismatch; 409 if the user is the last remaining admin

sessionEndpoints.list: GET /api/sessions -> [{ id, issuedAt, lastActiveAt, current }] — no IP, no user-agent, id is an opaque handle never the cookie value, only the caller's own sessions
sessionEndpoints.logout: POST /api/auth/logout — invalidates only the calling session
sessionEndpoints.logoutAll: POST /api/auth/logout-all — invalidates every session including the current one; no partial variant

idleLock.value: user-configurable 5-60 minutes, default 15, stored as idleLockMinutes in the encrypted profile record; out-of-range values clamped client-side; no 'never' option

mainCurrencyMutability.value: displayed, not editable in v1; import is the only path that replaces it, because import replaces the profile and every snapshot together

dimensionShape.value: dimensions: [{ id, label, archivedAt, values: [{ id, label, archivedAt }] }]

dimensionIdFormat.value: 8 characters of [a-z0-9] from crypto.getRandomValues, minted at creation, checked for uniqueness against the in-memory profile, never shown/typed/label-derived

dimensionOrderSemantics.value: order of dimensions[] is the dashboard 'Group by' select order; order of values[] is the stacked-chart band order, never resorted by size

deleteIsArchive.value: deleting a dimension or value sets archivedAt and leaves every account's dims entry untouched; no 'remove everywhere' operation exists anywhere in this feature

flagShape.value: a dimension with exactly one value is a 'flag', rendered by the account form as a checkbox rather than a select

singleRecordWriteRule.value: every dimensions-screen operation (create, rename, reorder, archive, restore) writes at most the one profile record; no account record is ever touched

fixtures: a user with records written before a password change, to prove post-change decryptability
two active sessions for one user, for the 'other sessions invalidated, initiating session survives' and 'logout invalidates only the calling session' criteria
a profile with idleLockMinutes at 0, 500, and a non-integer, for the clamping criterion
a profile with dimensions holding accounts assigned to values, for the archive/restore round-trip criteria
the last remaining admin's session, for the 409-on-self-delete criterion shared with admin-invites.md
focus: 'no operation in the dimensions feature writes more than one record' must be asserted by counting PUTs across create/rename/reorder/archive/restore, not by inspecting the UI's intent
the archive/restore round-trip criterion needs an actual byte-comparison of account records before and after, to prove nothing was rewritten
the change-password criterion 'server rejects a bad currentAuthKey even if the client-side unwrap were bypassed' requires calling the endpoint directly, not just exercising the UI form
GET /api/sessions must be asserted against its full response shape for absence of IP/user-agent/cookie value — a test that only checks the documented fields would miss an added leak
the last-admin delete guard is shared with admin-invites.md and must be tested on both DELETE /api/auth/account and the admin panel path — verify this contract's test doesn't silently only cover one
